files.legend.sop:
@legend.meta.worlds core.legend
    namespace=meta.worlds
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    doc="What a world is (cards), what is live this turn, what the message is made of, and the votes and blocks the routing rules derive from them"

# ---- a card: one per world (generated into kb.sop)
@meta.worlds.card core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="One world: its id, its tab, whether it needs something running, its names, action words, kinds of things and question frames. The words marked shared are used by more than two worlds and weigh little."
@meta.worlds.card.id core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world?"
@meta.worlds.card.tab core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which tab?"
@meta.worlds.card.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Tab or module?"
@meta.worlds.card.run core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Does it need something running?"
@meta.worlds.card.nav core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Does it open tabs?"
@meta.worlds.card.catalog core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Does it take any thing of the knowledge catalog?"
@meta.worlds.card.name core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="What is it called?"
@meta.worlds.card.navact core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which words open a tab?"
@meta.worlds.card.claim core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which words does it claim while its tab is open?"
@meta.worlds.card.act core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which action words belong to it?"
@meta.worlds.card.actshared core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which shared action words?"
@meta.worlds.card.thing core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which kinds of things does it hold or make?"
@meta.worlds.card.thingshared core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which shared things?"
@meta.worlds.card.frame core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which question frames?"

@meta.worlds.card.slot core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which kinds of values do its requests take (number, agent)?"

@meta.worlds.card.frameshared core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which question frames does it share with other worlds?"

# ---- facts about the words of the routing: words that start a game, worlds that act anywhere
@meta.worlds.start core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.start.word core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which word starts something?"
@meta.worlds.anywhere core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.anywhere.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world acts anywhere?"

# ---- live facts of the turn (told by the host)
@meta.worlds.live core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.live.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world?"
@meta.worlds.live.active core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it the open tab?"
@meta.worlds.live.running core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Does it have something running?"
@meta.worlds.live.asked core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Did it ask a question last turn?"
@meta.worlds.live.last core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Was it the world of the last action?"
@meta.worlds.live.notab core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is no tab open?"
@meta.worlds.live.refused core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Would the world refuse this message in the present state (a dry run told by the host)?"
@meta.worlds.live.recent core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Did it answer lately?"
@meta.worlds.scene core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.scene.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world?"
@meta.worlds.scene.thing core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which thing is in its scene?"
@meta.worlds.prior core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.prior.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world?"
@meta.worlds.prior.pts core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="How many points does the encoder give it?"

# ---- a word of a world's lexicons (derived by the host when the module loads, from the worlds' own lexicon declarations; told per message for the words it has)
@meta.worlds.lex core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.lex.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world's lexicon has the word?"
@meta.worlds.lex.word core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which word?"
@meta.worlds.lex.scope core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Does one or two worlds have the word (own) or three or four (shared)?"

# ---- the message
@meta.worlds.msg core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.msg.word core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which words (and word pairs) does it have?"
@meta.worlds.msg.frag core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it a piece without a verb of its own?"
@meta.worlds.msg.slotword core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which kinds of values does it have (number, agent)?"
@meta.worlds.msg.catalog core.key
    value=atom
    card=many
    ask="Which words are things of the knowledge catalog?"

# ---- derived
@meta.worlds.starts core.type
    extends=core.state
@meta.worlds.starts.yes core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Does the message start something?"
@meta.worlds.vote core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A reason for a world: the rule that fired, its points and the word it rests on"
@meta.worlds.vote.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world?"
@meta.worlds.vote.rule core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which rule?"
@meta.worlds.vote.weight core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="How many points?"
@meta.worlds.vote.via core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which word?"
@meta.worlds.block core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A reason a world cannot take the message"
@meta.worlds.block.world core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which world?"
@meta.worlds.block.rule core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which rule?"
@meta.worlds.say core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The plain words of the reason a rule gives; {via} is the word it rests on, {name} the world's everyday name"
@meta.worlds.say.rule core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which rule?"
@meta.worlds.say.text core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What does it say?"
files.world.sop:
@world.meta.worlds core.world
    namespace=meta.worlds
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.meta.worlds
    imports=world.core
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="World of worlds"
    summary=""
    doc="A shared module that knows what each world is and picks the world that should take a message, by rules with reasons (WORLD-OF-WORLDS experiment, spec 20). It is not a tab and never a routing candidate: it has no patterns and no operations. kb.sop holds one generated card per world (scripts/build-world-cards.mjs: names, action words, kinds of things, question frames, whether the world needs something running); the host tells it what is live each turn (the open tab, what runs, what the scenes hold, the last action, a question asked) and what the message is made of; matrix.sop holds the rules (named, asked, follow-up, referent, action and kind, open tab, nothing running, no continuation, the encoder as one prior). Every vote carries the rule and its reason, which the trace says in plain words. A new world is added by its card alone. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
